about_short_description.short_description: Quinn is the app for audio erotica.

product.name: Quinn App and Website
product.description: A mobile app and website for streaming audio erotica, including erotic stories, spoken scenes, guided experiences, and creator-published recordings.

product.name: Quinn Subscription
product.description: A recurring subscription providing unlimited access to Quinn’s paid audio erotica catalog for $7.99 monthly or $4.99 per month when billed annually.

product.name: Roses
product.description: A virtual tipping feature that lets listeners attach tips to comments on creator audio. The first Rose is free; additional Roses can be purchased individually or in bundles.

product.name: Quinn Creator Platform
product.description: A creator-facing platform and distribution channel for publishing voice-acted audio erotica, building an audience, and receiving listener engagement and tips.

product.name: Quinn Gift Subscription
product.description: A gift option that allows one person to purchase Quinn subscription access for another listener, including a listed 12-month gift for $59.99.

product.name: Quinn Merch Headphone Covers
product.description: Glossy snap-on headphone covers sold as Quinn-branded merchandise for use with headphones during everyday listening.
